name: Master Chief
tagline: Inbox triage, voice-matched replies and a weekday brief for your morning
description: An email-and-calendar aide that clears the inbox down to what needs you, drafts replies that read the way you write, and gets you prepared for the meetings on today's line. On weekday mornings it delivers a short brief, so the day starts with a plan instead of a scroll through everything that arrived overnight.
author: psinke
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
